mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_ip_block WHERE source_ip=#{ip} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_ip_block(id, source_ip, status, reason_code, failed_attempts, window_seconds, blocked_at, version) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.sourceIp}, 'RELEASED', 'LOGIN_FAILURE_THRESHOLD', 0, #{row.windowSeconds}, #{row.blockedAt}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_ip=VALUES(source_ip)
